# Logic model fixtures

PROPOSED, NOT CLINICALLY CONFIRMED, AWAITING MEDIC.

- `v1.json`: copy of the team's final logic model (logic-model/pathways/cough_fast_breathing/v1.json, 7 rules R1 to R7, 7 outcomes; also the git-ignored repo root v1.json). Golden reference for the parser, interpreter and grid tests.
- `golden-testcases.json`: the golden cases, the default the checks read (`src/signoff/checkInputs.ts`). Synthetic answers, no patient data. Two groups:
  - GF01 to GF12: Medic confirmed, from `golden-cases-final-12-annotated.xlsx` (written by PlainSight, 2026-11-04, `medic_confirmed: Yes`). GF01 to GF06 treat fast breathing at home (R5); GF07, GF09, GF10 and GF11 refer urgently with a first antibiotic dose (R3); GF08 and GF12 refer urgently (R4). Converting the sheet: its 21 answer columns map onto the 9 questions of v1.json. `not_able_to_drink_or_feed` and `vomits_everything` are false because the sheet only asks them after "difficulty drinking or feeding" or "vomiting" is yes, and both are no in all 12 cases. Diarrhoea, fever, MUAC, swelling of both feet, HIV, TB contact and other problem have no question in v1.json and are left out. The expected medicines, advice and follow-up from the sheet are kept in each case's note.
  - g01 to g20: PROPOSED, NOT CLINICALLY CONFIRMED, AWAITING MEDIC (formerly `golden-proposed.json`). Derived only from v1.json and the booklet content already in it; each needs clinician review before it is treated as ground truth. Case g05 depends on open question Q1 (12 months), g08, g09, g15, g17, g18 and g19 on Q2 (outside the age range). g15 and g17 (1 month old with convulsions or chest indrawing) now expect refer_urgent_outside_age_range through R1: the old hazard, where a lower-severity out-of-range rule fired before the danger-sign rule, is fixed. g16 (infant with a danger sign and fast breathing) and g17 pin which of two equally urgent overlapping results a child gets (red team 1, M81): the URGENT_OVERLAP_UNTESTED check asks for such a case.

  Together they cover every outcome. Tested by `tests/logic/goldenTestcases.test.ts`.
